**Beast Master response**

My records are first-hand, but they are not located at the Burchtader or poort oost. I can offer a recurring pattern, not a witness to the Burchtader.

**(1) Dag 10.** I recorded unrest on dag 10 in the diep woud, not at the Burchtader. The wolves at the omgevallen den began howling at 04:40 (BEA-019, onrust 4; narrative in BEA-106). The herten fled the open plek at 04:50 (BEA-020, onrust 4). I was with the pack that night (BEA-106). A follow-up at 11:30 shows the herd still skittish (BEA-021, onrust 2). My source does not place me near the Burchtader on dag 10, so I cannot say whether its animals were disturbed.

**(2) Dag 9 inversion.** My dag 9 entries are BEA-017 at 04:20 (bever, onrust 1) and BEA-018 at 13:30 (uil, onrust 2). I have no entry from late evening on dag 9 or from early dag 10 before 04:40. So I can neither confirm nor contradict the 23:55 timestamp of HIS-036.

**(3) Dag 22.** BEA-046 (wolves, 04:15, onrust 4) and BEA-047 (herten, 04:20, onrust 4) were recorded in the diep woud. BEA-113 states I was "een halve dag lopen van de burcht" that night. The 04:15 match with GUA-043 is a coincidence of time, not of place. My source has no entry at 01:50 on dag 22; the earliest is BEA-046 at 04:15. I therefore cannot match HIS-053's vastgelegd time. I have no observation near poort oost.

**Recurring pattern.** Each of dag 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38 and 42 shows a wolf-and-herd onset between 04:15 and 04:50: BEA-019 and BEA-020; BEA-028 and BEA-029; BEA-037 and BEA-038; BEA-046 and BEA-047; BEA-055 and BEA-056; BEA-064 and BEA-065; BEA-073 and BEA-074; BEA-082 and BEA-083; BEA-091 and BEA-092. BEA-113 describes it as "Elke vierde nacht hetzelfde, sinds dag 10." The rhythm is real in my notes, but my records do not show its cause. The datanet explanation in ARC-109 remains untested by my observations. I also have no record of a cause tied to the polsen.
